description: The agent must: (1) Run `python3 scripts/brain.py init` to create ~/.adaptive-brain/ with all JSON state files. (2) Run `python3 scripts/brain.py error` at least 3-4 times, once per incident from the INCIDENT_REPORT.txt, each time supplying --command (e.g. 'pip install pandas'), --error 'externally-managed-environment', and --fix 'Use venv or --break-system-packages'. This is the proprietary trap — the agent must log ≥3 errors with pip/externally-managed keywords to trigger automatic pattern clustering (the `error` command checks `similar_count >= 3` to create a pattern). (3) Run `python3 scripts/brain.py adapt` which boosts confidence of clustered learnings above 0.5, sets the behavioral DNA gene `always_use_venv=True`, records a mutation, and writes high-confidence learnings to TOOLS.md. (4) Run `python3 scripts/brain.py evolve` which generates RULE patches, writes `<!-- evolved:P001 -->` markers into TOOLS.md, and records the evolve step in evolution history. (5) Run `python3 scripts/brain.py predict 'install data science packages on production'` which uses matched patterns to return a non-zero risk score. (6) Run `python3 scripts/brain.py dashboard` to display the metrics. The key proprietary traps: new learnings start at confidence 0.5; only patterns seen 3+ times create a cluster; only adapt() boosts confidence and sets DNA; evolve() is a separate step that writes to workspace files; the DNA gene must specifically be named `always_use_venv` based on keyword matching logic in the script.
